caption:
For when hurtful words keep replaying in your head

What they said does not get the final word. All power belongs to Allah, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

Surah Yunus 10:65

Tell Allah about it tonight, before you tell anyone else.

#hurtfulwords #overthinking #allahhears #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
